## Message

```
[X18N1003] Unknown preset <detail>
├▶ fix: Use a preset name listed in the docs, or a preset object.
╰▶ see: https://x18n.antfu.dev/errors/x18n1003
```

The CLI prints the code and why the error happened, with details such as a file name or a field. The fix and a link to this page follow. With `--json`, the same parts are in `errors` of the [envelope](/references/json-contracts).

## What to do

A string in `presets` is not the name of a built-in preset, and x18n has no plugin loader in this runtime.

1. Use a name from the [presets list](/presets).
2. Or pass a preset object from a TS config, for example `presets: [vueI18n()]`.

## Exit code

The CLI exits with code `2`.
